leftEvidence.title: Cloud and fire go before Israel while the people take the wilderness road

points.label: Cloud
points.left: The pillar of cloud leads by day and does not depart from before the people.
points.right: The ancestors are described as all under the cloud.

points.label: Moses and movement
points.left: Moses carries Joseph’s bones as Israel travels toward the sea.
points.right: Those under cloud and passing through sea are described with Moses.

points.label: Scope
points.left: The Scene concentrates on route, bones, cloud, and fire at the beginning of the journey.
points.right: The later passage also gathers sea, food, drink, and wilderness death.

payload.posture: Inspect how a later catalogue gathers several Exodus and wilderness elements without collapsing their original Scenes.

rightEvidence.title: Paul recalls cloud, sea, Moses, food, water, and wilderness death

payload.tension: Inspect how a later catalogue gathers several Exodus and wilderness elements without collapsing their original Scenes.
payload.title: Cloud leads / cloud and sea recalled
